'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*A [[Shootout|gunfight]] during a security operation in [[North Waziristan District]], [[Pakistan]], results in the death of seven security forces and five terrorists. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1646554 (Dawn)]

'''Business and economy'''
* Property giant [[Evergrande_Group|China Evergrande Group]] admitted it is under "tremendous pressure" and may not be able to meet its crippling debt obligations. Angry protesters have been gathering outside the real estate firm's headquarters, demanding to know about its future. Evergrande is holding [[United States dollar|$]]305 billion in liabilities on $147 billion in assets reported in 2020. [https://www.dw.com/en/evergrande-why-the-chinese-property-giant-is-close-to-collapse/a-59175953 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three people are killed and at least 60 more injured during a 6.0 [[earthquake]] in [[Yongchuan District|Yongchuan]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/09/16/china/sichuan-earthquake-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]] 
****The percentage of people who have received their first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia|COVID-19 vaccine]] in [[New South Wales]] surpasses 80%. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/vaccines/nsw-vaccine-rollout-at-highest-in-edmonson-park-and-schofields-while-inner-city-suburbs-lag-behind-c-3969818 (7 News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Alberta]]
*****[[Premier of Alberta|Alberta premier]] [[Jason Kenney]] declares a public health emergency and introduces [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|vaccine passport]] system that will give businesses the choice between tough restrictions or demanding customers show proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Canada|vaccination]] or a [[COVID-19 testing|negative test]] due to the rising number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/amp/canada/alberta/article-alberta-declares-health-emergency-will-bring-in-vaccine-passports-as/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****One in every 500 Americans have died from COVID-19 since the start of the pandemic in the U.S. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/15/health/us-coronavirus-wednesday/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
***The [[Chile]]an [[Ministry of Health (Chile)|health ministry]] announces that beginning from October 1, Chileans, resident and non-resident foreigners will be able to leave and enter the country. [https://www.aviacionline.com/2021/09/chile-announces-border-opening-as-of-october-1/ (Aviacionline)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mongolia]]
***[[Mongolia]] reports its first animal [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]] from [[COVID-19]] in two beavers from the Beaver Breeding Center at the Environmental Department of the capital [[Ulaanbaatar]] last month. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-09/15/c_1310188921.htm (Xinhuanet)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovenia]]
***[[Slovenia]] begins to implement a mandatory COVID pass for people aged over 12 years old, containing proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Slovenia|vaccination]], a negative test, or have recovered from COVID-19 in the previous six months in order to enter all service establishments and workplaces with the exception of emergency medical service, grocery stores, and chemists. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/short_news/slovenia/ (Euractiv)]

'''International relations'''
*[[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Joe Biden]], [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|U.K. prime minister]] [[Boris Johnson]], and [[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian prime minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] announce the formation of a new security alliance, named [[AUKUS]], aimed at countering [[China]]'s growing influence in the [[Indo-Pacific#Geopolitical context|Indo-Pacific]] region. They also announce, as part of the alliance's first initiative, the [[Royal Australian Navy]] will be acquiring [[Nuclear submarine|nuclear-powered submarines]].  [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-58564837 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Philippine drug war]]
**The Pre-Trial Chamber of the [[International Criminal Court]] authorizes the [[Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court|Prosecutor]] to launch an investigation into the [[Government of the Philippines|Philippine government]] under [[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] for possible [[crimes against humanity]] committed during the drug war. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2021/09/16/duterte-icc-killings-investigation-philippines/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Russian legislative election]]
**Allies of [[Russian opposition]] activist [[Alexei Navalny]], especially [[Leonid Volkov (politician)|Leonid Volkov]], call to vote for the [[Communist Party of the Russian Federation]] in the upcoming [[Federal Assembly (Russia)|parliamentary]] election in order to hurt the ruling [[United Russia]] party. Navalny and his allies' party was barred from the election after being branded as "extremist" last June. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kremlin-critic-navalnys-allies-say-vote-communist-hurt-ruling-party-2021-09-15/ (Reuters)]
*Aftermath of the [[2021 Argentine legislative election]]
**Interior minister and vice president [[Cristina Fernández de Kirchner]]'s ally [[Eduardo de Pedro]] offers his resignation following the defeat of the ruling [[Frente de Todos|center-left government]] in last Sunday's midterm primaries. Culture minister [[Tristán Bauer]], environment minister [[Juan Cabandié]] and science and technology minister [[Roberto Salvarezza]], all close to Kirchner, also resign. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-interior-minister-resigns-after-government-election-blow-2021-09-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[USA Gymnastics sex abuse scandal]]
**[[Simone Biles]] and three other U.S. gymnasts testify before [[United States Congress|Congress]] about the long-term sexual abuse of women in [[USA Gymnastics]] by team doctor [[Larry Nassar]] and the lack of investigation by the [[FBI]] after the abuse was initially reported in 2015. [https://apnews.com/article/simone-biles-gymnastics-sexual-abuse-larry-nassar-cb63ffbfd09d9d4ffe21561aa63d3ca5 (AP News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Russia]] demonstrates the use of [[unmanned ground vehicle]]s in combat formations during the weeklong Zapad joint military exercises with [[Belarus]]. The two vehicles demonstrated were the [[Uran-9]], a tracked vehicle equipped with a 30 mm autocannon, machine gun, anti-tank missiles and a flamethrower; and the Nerekhta, equipped with a mounted machine gun and a grenade launcher as well as cargo capacity. [https://www.military.com/daily-news/2021/09/15/russia-claims-battlefield-breakthrough-robot-tanks.html (Military.com)]
*[[TikTok]] announces that they have banned the [[devious lick]] challenge, which saw videos of students stealing items from schools, such as [[soap dispenser|soap dispensers]]. [https://www.insider.com/devious-lick-tiktok-steal-from-school-community-guidelines-criminal-2021-9 (Business Insider)]
